text_block_list.text:
Starting today, Tracen Academy's traditional
Summer Training Camp begins!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
My family's dojo held summer training camps by the beach, too.
It feels rather nostalgic.

Sakura Chiyono O and Mejiro Ardan, who were
recovering from injuries, spotted Yaeno Muteki
and called out to her.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O-san, Ardan-san!
You're participating in the training camp too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, it's a much better change of pace
than staying cooped up in the dorms!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
See? Even with an injury,
I can still train.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Racing... is out of the question for a while, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Neither Chiyono O-san nor I are ready yet.
It might be difficult before the year is out...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I didn't care if my legs gave out—that was the conviction
with which I wagered everything on the Derby.
And I have no regrets.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
However... I still feel the frustration.
I wanted to compete in the Kikuka Sho once more.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Yaeno-san.
It's frustrating, but I'll still be rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Good luck in the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I will run a race worthy of you both, without fail.

The feelings of her rival who couldn't run fire up Yaeno Muteki even more.
It looks like it's going to be an intense summer training camp.
